label: sec:mass-open-problems-intro
html: This concluding section catalogues the open mathematical problems of the mass-tower programme and formulates each as an explicit algebraic or geometric target: the terminal resolution of the hadronic scale E_0 from first principles, the closed-form generation of mass directly from the Hecke generators without intermediate triangulation, the all-order volume-tower decomposition, and the crystal-basis reduction of the remaining multi-strand SDP classes.
